projectPendingNodeRemoval.warning.en: These nodes and all their details will move to this draft’s pending list. You can undo for 5 seconds. Nothing is deleted from the server.
projectPendingNodeRemoval.warning.zh-Hans: 这些节点及全部内容会移入当前草稿的待编排区，5 秒内可以撤销。不会删除服务器上的内容。

projectPendingNodeRemoval.moved.en: Moved to pending. Undo is available for 5 seconds.
projectPendingNodeRemoval.moved.zh-Hans: 已移入待编排区，5 秒内可撤销。

projectPendingNodeRemoval.guest.en: This guest draft stays in memory and is not saved to your account.
projectPendingNodeRemoval.guest.zh-Hans: 访客草稿仅保留在内存中，不会保存到账户。

projectPendingNodeRemoval.saveUnconfirme.en: Local save was not confirmed. All node content remains in the current draft. Reopen the draft to inspect its saved state before trying again.
projectPendingNodeRemoval.saveUnconfirme.zh-Hans: 本地保存结果未确认，节点内容仍保留在当前草稿中。请重新打开草稿，核对保存状态后再操作。
